deskyard volume list: list the volumes

Usage: deskyard [-e ENV] volume list [--json]

Lists the volumes (shared folders in the server's data folder, mounted at
/share/NAME) and the environments they are granted to.

Options:
  --json               print JSON instead of text

Prints: a table NAME ENVIRONMENTS FOLDER CREATED; with --json the API's answer
  {volumes:[Volume]}

Examples:
  deskyard volume list

Where: on this machine, talking to the chosen server: the one -e SERVER/ (or -e SERVER/ENV) names, else the default server
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; the server's refusal (403 for what your account may not do) is an error
